species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 56°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 12–32 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 75 ft, so fish stay above it.
